rows.comment: Bergman (who does everything) has achieved remarkable magic with his camera and with his cast

rows.dek_lead: Bergman (who does everything) has achieved remarkable magic with his camera and with his cast. Max von Sydow as the magician is a haunting figure who floats between the realms of an agonized mystic and a vulgar charlatan.
